_timing: No narration yet. Each beat is the larger of the time it needs to finish animating and the time it takes to read, plus a 22-frame hold. This is a floor, not considered pacing — measure a real read and switch this topic to voiceCuts.

beats.text: Europe's new rocket destroyed itself on its first flight.
beats.note: Ariane 5 flight 501 carried four Cluster research satellites of about 1,200 kg each. Wikipedia puts the loss at more than US$370 million.

beats.context: From lift-off until the rocket veered off course. The inquiry timed the first navigation unit failure at 36.7 seconds.

beats.text: One number was too big for the box it was put in.
beats.note: A 64-bit floating point value was converted to a 16-bit signed integer, and it overflowed. The conversion was not protected.

beats.text: Four risky variables were guarded. Three were not.
beats.note: Seven variables were at risk. The inquiry says protection was left out because of a maximum workload target of 80%.

beats.text: The software was reused from Ariane 4.
beats.note: Ariane 5 builds up horizontal speed five times faster. The alignment function that failed was kept for commonality and was not needed on Ariane 5.

beats.text: The computer did what its specification said.
beats.note: On an error, the processor was specified to shut down. The back-up unit failed first, then the active one about 0.05 seconds later.

beats.text: The part that failed had no job to do once the rocket left the ground.
